balls.text: Ramandeep finishes on 25 in 6 balls! Shin-high full toss on middle, and Ramandeep absolutely clatters that over deep midwicket. Beautiful sound off the bat as the ball goes into orbit. KKR finish on 235 for 6
short ball, pace off, but with some width too. Ramandeep waits on it and simply helps the ball over short third, toying with the field after spotting Thakur's plan
full ball just outside off and drilled to long off for a single

KL with a stunning catch! Slower ball bouncer on middle and leg. Iyer attempts the pull behind square but ends up gloving it. Rahul dives to his left, at full stretch with his left-hand sticking out, and the ball stays glued! Thakur folds his hands in admiration of Rahul. Rubbish line but great result.
yorker length, on middle. But Iyer manages to eke out two from that by nudging a shot towards midwicket where nobody is present
full ball on middle and leg. Iyer closes his bat's face quickly and ensures the flick is played between deep square leg and fine leg. Pierces the gap in beautiful fashion

back of a length slower ball on middle and leg. Iyer pulls and misses as the ball goes down the leg side. The umpire does not give it a wide so Iyer reviews. The umpire is forced to change his decision as the TV umpire agrees with the batter

long on puts his body on the line, but in vain! Half-tracker around off, and it sits up really well for Ramandeep. Stands tall and flat-bats a shot over the non-striker's head. Naveen at long on thought he could parry it back, but ends up retrieving the ball from beyond the digital advertising
overpitched ball just outside off. Iyer fails to get his bat under it properly. Toe-ends a shot to long off
back of a length slower ball outside off. Ramandeep tries to swat it over the leg side but he slices the shot. Ball goes high up but lands safe between the non-striker's area and mid-on
shovels a six over cow corner! Full ball on off and middle. Ramandeep clears the front leg and uses his powerful arms to send the ball over the leg side
full-pace short ball angling into Ramandeep. He is pushed deep in his crease but manages to pull in front of square for a couple

Iyer pre-meditates but cannot get more than one. He got in position to play a scoop behind the keeper but the full ball around off forces Iyer to bunt it to the off side timidly for one. Think he was expecting a ball wider outside off

Stoinis at square leg makes no mistake! Bowls the bouncer but also rolls his fingers over the ball. Rinku tries to get under the ball and hook it over backward square leg, but it hits him high on the bat. The ball pops up for square leg's simple grab. Rinku's struggles continue
searches for the yorker outside off. But Rinku is up for the challenge. Opens the bat's face and puts some direction behind that ball. Boundary to backward point and brings up KKR's 200.
full ball wide-ish outside off. Iyer tonks it towards long off, and it gets to the fielder on the bounce

full ball, sixth-stump line. Iyer reaches out and drags a strong shot back over Naveen's head. Doesn't pick the slower ball at first but adjusts while playing the stroke, and sends it just past long on running around
short ball outside off with pace off. Iyer tries to slap it over backward point but he is deceived by the change of pace
yorker, well almost, just outside off. Rinku can only bunt the ball to the off side for one
short ball around leg and this time the pull is played along the carpet. Only a single
slower ball, fullish just outside off. He backs away but then opts to play a checked cut after spotting the pace and line
again a full toss on his shin, around leg stump. Shreyas clips it towards fine leg for a couple more

Rinku nearly falls into the trap. Both deep square leg and fine leg were on the line for Rinku to pull, and he goes for it once he spots the short ball. Krunal runs in and tries to take a low catch but the ball lands just short of him. Full marks for effort
low full toss around off and clipped to deep midwicket. But mistimed from him on this occasion

technically that's six off one ball! Nearly a waist high full toss around leg stump, and Iyer does not miss out this time. Flicked very fine, beating the fielder at short fine leg. His first four of the night

aiming for Iyer's heel, bowling a yorker just outside leg. Iyer gets in position for the flick towards fine leg but misses. The umpire does not call it a wide so the KKR captain reviews for a wide run. Iyer's shout is successful. Decision overturned.
overpitched ball lands beyond the batter, and also beyond the leg side. Wide to start off. On the bounce to Rahul
full ball clattered to cover for a single, but it is a risky one since the fielder has a shy at the stumps. But Shreyas is safe since it is not a direct hit
full ball on leg and worked to the leg side for a single
dropkick to cow corner for four. Slot ball on leg and middle. Rinku has a still head and uses his wrists to lift it off his toes for four
full ball just outside off. Tap and run to the off side
short and wide ball, and Shreyas Iyer will be disappointed missing out on that. Finds air trying to cut

dream start for Yudhvir! A wicket first ball and he folds his hands in celebration. Back of a length ball outside off. Raghuvanshi tries to play it towards deep third by attempting to poke it, but all it does is take an edge to the wicketkeeper
full ball on middle. Pace off. Rinku gently dabs it to midwicket where there's acres of space. Easy two runs to end the over
change of pace. Good length ball on middle and leg. Rinku comes down the track but has to check his shot. Blocked to Naveen
Rinku is off the mark with a couple. Pulls this short ball with Naveen coming around the wicket. Sent to fine leg's right for two
full ball on off stump and Rinku tentatively fends it

stunning catch by K Gowtham! Naveen does not change his plans despite the adversity. Goes full and wide again, and Russell toe-ends the attempted launch over cover. Ball goes high up and three fielders look to converge but it is K Gowtham, who turns and runs back from cover, who dives away from the action, facing the crowd, and takes a brilliant two-hander. Russell gone for a strike-rate of 150
full ball, flirting with the tram-lines again. Russell reaches out to slap it over cover but this time he can't connect. Umpire gives it a wide but LSG review the decision. They lose the review
they probably discussed this in the batting meetings last night. Naveen does indeed go full and wide. Russell hangs back before reaching out and swatting it straight back down the ground
Bishnoi finishes with 1-33 Length ball on middle, and turning into Russell. Uncomfortably nurdled away to short fine for a quick single
full ball on middle. Turning in sharply and hitting Russell on the pads. But impact is outside leg stump so they don't bother appealing
full ball on off. Turning into his pads and worked to short fine for a quick single
full ball outside off. Raghuvanshi uses his feet to play an expansive flick through the midwicket region. But this time the shot is inside-edged onto his thigh
fullish ball turning in and going down leg. Raghuvanshi happy to let that one go

into the thirties with that. Comes down the track and converts this full ball around off stump into a full toss. Toe-ends the shot but hits a shot through the ball's line, and it falls just short of the boundary line
full ball outside off. Googly, and Raghuvanshi gets low for the sweep. He misses and he's lucky his off stump is still upright
full ball on middle. Slowing things down against Raghuvanshi. Clipped to square leg for a single although they were interested for two
length ball around off. Russell is surprised by that line and ends up poking at the ball tentatively. Knocked to point
fullish ball, outside off, too wide outside off in fact. Russell offers no shot and collects the freebie
#HereWeGo. Pandya misses his length, and Russell sends him over long on. Overpitched ball around leg, and enough time for Russell to get his bat under it
uh oh, Pandya! Tries to keep that leg-stump line to Russell, but the ball ends up sliding down the leg side. Russell, for his part, tried to play the sweep
full ball on leg. Russell tries to play it leg side but he misses again. Hits his pad
length ball on middle and leg. Russell tries to clip it towards fine leg but it hits his pad
full ball on middle stump, and knocks it to the leg side. Gets Andre Russell on strike

holes out for 81 and finally Bishnoi can smile. He went full outside off, and Narine ended up slicing this shot down the V. Padikkal, from long off, takes a few steps in, and this time takes a clean catch. Bishnoi pats Narine on the back as the allrounder trods out of the ground. Another stunning innings from the maestro
full ball outside off. Turning in. Toe-ends a drive to long on
full ball on leg. Turning towards off. Narine clobbers a shot across the line to wide long on

quicker ball, sliding across Narine, and he tries to play a cut. Deceived by the extra speed, and the shot is edged towards deep third. Mohsin dives to his right to take a one-hander, but the ball doesn't stick, and he hits his head on the way down. The batters take two and the physio runs in to check on Mohsin

Caught at long off! No! He has stepped over! 32nd six for Narine in IPL 2024! Puts his dancing shoes on and mistimes the googly. Ball goes high in the night sky but Padikkal at long off gets under it to pouch the catch. But while he takes the catch, he also steps onto the boundary line. Real-life Lagaan
full ball wider outside off. Raghuvanshi drills the googly to wide long on, but there's a man on the line

short of good length ball around leg stump. Narine stands deep in his crease and pulls from chest height. No chance for either deep midwicket or deep square leg on the boundary line as Narine clears the longer side of the boundary with ease once more.
slower ball swatted away! Stoinis tries to roll his fingers over this ball. Gets it to land around off, and Narine simply goes for his tried-and-tested method of swinging across the line
offcutter. Full and wide, and going further wide. Narine chases after the ball and tries to hit it over cover but misses. Stoinis applauds after the ball, not sure whether to the batter or the keeper

out of here! Full ball around leg, and it is easy pickings for Narine once he clears the front leg. Converts it onto a slot ball by ensuring his feet are nowhere near, and then launches Stoinis over long on
short ball on leg stump. Narine standing deep in his crease tries to hook it behind square. Misses
length ball angling into him. Mistimed pull in front of square but the single will nonetheless bring up another fifty stand
full around off. Googly turning in, and worked to square leg for a single. They wanted two at first
overpitched and punished! Tossed up a bit this time. But its very wide and very full. Raghuvanshi climbs into the cover drive, and slaps it past the man placed at cover for four
full ball just outside leg. Narine attempts a slog sweep, but he's beaten by the zippy nature of the delivery. Inside edge to the leg side
full ball on his toes, around leg stump. Narine misses the swipe, and the ball hits his toes.
tries the reverse sweep but misses. Bishnoi's googlies are getting predictable, and Narine tries to play the reverse sweep behind conventional point but can't get bat on ball
deft touch, and fifty for Narine! Length ball on leg and turning sharply across him. Narine sticks the horizontal bat out, and plays it very late, past slip and past short third!
comes down the track and converts this fullish ball into a low full toss. Toe-ends a shot to long on for one. Team hundred in nine overs
short ball again. Thakur has a big heart and attempts the same delivery. Narine attempts the pull but extra bounce on this occasion forces him to only find air. Through to Rahul

only two short of fifty! Thakur comes around the stumps and bowls a short ball on middle stump. Narine stands tall, gets on the front foot, and pulls to the longer side of this ground. Clears the deep square leg fence by a long way!
length ball, fifth-stump line. Tries to punch through the off side but takes an edge to deep third
the tall man pulls the short ball for six! Thakur bends his back, but Raghuvanshi is blessed with a good height. Pulls this neck-high ball over the fielder manning deep square leg

Raghuvanshi survives a run-out chance! Big mix-up but LSG can't capitalise. Raghuavnshi struck this full ball to midwicket's left, but Padikkal swiftly moved across the surface to intercept. Narine was ball-watching and not running, forcing Raghuvanshi to turn back after coming halfway down. Padikkal's throw isn't a direct hit, and KL Rahul struggles to collect cleanly too
Full ball outside off stump. Its the legbreak for a change. Gets low and sweeps against the turn to deep midwicket. Only five off the over.
full ball drifting and landing on middle and leg. Turning further down. Wide given
fullish ball on leg. Narine stays on the back foot and flicks this skidder to the leg side for one
full ball outside off. Googly is smothered to wide long on with the turn this time
full ball outside off. Googly turning in. Raghuvanshi offers a compact defensive shot to the off side
full ball, bit wider outside off and turning further away. Mistimed cut slapped to point for one
googly to start off. Length ball on off and turning away. Narine tries to play a late cut but misses
short of good length around leg stump. Narine tucks it off his waist to midwicket for a single
works this length ball off his body to short fine leg's region for a single

sliced but lands well short of long off. Krunal drops his length and Narine awkwardly flat-bats a shot down the ground. He's lucky the timing was so poor, otherwise he'd have hit it straight to Naveen at long off

that's massive! This is a big ground and Narine sends it 5 rows back anyway. Full ball on off stump, and Narine is not bothered by that area being the longest part of this venue. In his arc, and smacked over deep midwicket
full ball on middle and leg stump. Fended to the leg side with the ball angling into his pads
length ball on leg and nudged off his body to the leg side for a single
only two off the sixth over but KKR post 70/1 in the powerplay. This was a length ball on off and middle stump, and all Raghuvanshi can do is fend it to the leg side. Time out
back of a length ball angling into his body. Uncomfortably pulled, but manages to get it over the fielder at midwicket. Lands safe near cow corner
full all on leg stump. Narine clears the front leg and looks to drive down the V, but can't clear mid-off despite hitting it well
around the stumps to Narine. Full ball outside leg with Narine continuing to back away. Driven to cover, where there's a fielder. Thakur takes a tumble on his followthrough
full ball on middle. He backs away and slaps a mistimed shot back past the bowler to long on
dot ball from Thakur first up. Full ball on middle and Raghuvanshi fends this gently back towards the non-striker
around the stumps. Full, slow ball just outside leg stump. Narine makes room so he can stay leg-side of the ball and swings across the line. Mistimed to deep midwicket for a couple
good length ball, outside off stump. Pace off again. Nudged to the off side for a quick single
full and very wide. But Raghuvanshi dances down the track, reaches out, and uses his long arms to meet the ball well. Drives this 110kph delivery through the covers!
low full toss on middle and leg. Comfortably blocked to mid on

strong response from Naveen! The bowler goes slow, entices Salt with a full and wide ball, and the change of pace does the trick. Salt throws his bat at it, looking to pump another boundary through the off side, but the has flummoxed him. Takes an edge, flies to Rahul's right, and the keeper dives to seal the deal.
the onslaught continues! Overpitched ball outside off and Salt drives with the bat's open face. Ensures the shot is played squarer than usual, and he gets a boundary away behind point

going, going, gone! Mohsin attempts a short ball again, full-paced, and Narine also tries to pull once more. This time he gets it off the bat's sweet spot, and the ball flies high into the night sky, over deep backward square leg. 20 runs off that over.
bouncer attempted. Short ball angling into Narine but bouncing too much. Wide given as he misses the pull
length ball outside off stump. Tries to go after Mohsin again, attempting to slap a shot over the off side. Misses
flat-batted down the ground! Mohsin drops his length to test Narine. But it's not short enough. A fullish ball gets to him at waist-height, and he clatters this rising delivery past mid-on's right

that's more like it! Full ball outside off again. Narine clears the front leg, and this time he hammers a drive through the covers. Ball much closer to his body this time, and he got under it very well
a one-handed swat over cover! Mohsin bowls a full ball wider outside off, only 123kph. Narine commits to the shot and loses the grip of one hand, but manages to do enough to clear the cover fielder
full ball on leg and clipped away to deep square leg. They consider two but the fielder swiftly cleans up

just clears short fine leg and that's a 19-run over! Slower ball, full outside leg. Narine plays a flick but doesn't offer a full followthrough and the shot is lobbed behind. Fielder attempts valiantly, but can neither take the catch nor stop the runs
Naveen attempts a yorker on leg stump. But Narine backs away to make room and the full toss ends up being a very low full toss. Narine slices a shot while backing away, and gets it past cover point!
slower ball, full on off and middle. Salt doesn't commit early to an expansive shot, and instead plays it gently back to Naveen after spotting the pace
full outside off again. Salt clatters this away from his body, but this time it won't be a boundary. Deep extra cover cleans up
crrrrrrunched! Naveen over-corrects his line. Full ball, but this time outside off stump. Salt shuffles forward before meeting the ball for a glorious drive past cover's right

welcomed with a boundary through deep backward square leg. Naveen delivers a full ball from that wide release from the crease, and the ball angles in sharply into Salt. He helps it for four, using the pace nicely
pace-off ball and Narine swings and misses. A good over from Mohsin, barring that six by Salt
short ball around off and middle. Narine takes his eyes off but attempts the pull nonetheless. Misses
good length ball on leg. Skiddy delivery. Knocked off his waist to the leg side for a quick single
swiveled and put away! Short of a good length, around leg stump, Salt needs no second invitation. Goes top to bottom in his bat swing across the line to get the elevation. 69m six behind square
good length ball around leg. Salt wants to push it towards midwicket but misses the connection. Hits him on the pad
nearly a yorker on off. Narine bends and opens the bat's face late to guide the shot to deep third
chance of a catch?! Full ball angling across and Narine throws his hands at it to try and clear mid off. But he slices the shot, giving LSG hopes of a catch, but nope, lands well short
Fullish ball on leg, shaping into Narine with the batter making room and trying to hit over the leg side. Misses, and hits him on the leg
full ball on middle and leg. Gently tapped in front of mid-on, and that's enough time for the single. The direct hit lights the stumps up, but Salt was way in
tickled! Length ball angling into his hip. Ball swinging in too much, and Salt only has to help it along its way by closing the bat's face to fine leg
full ball around off and Salt tries to play it to the leg side. Misses, hits his pad. Angle would've probably taken it down leg stump

surprised by the bounce off the pitch, and top-edged over the keeper! A short of good length ball around off. Salt shapes up to pull but realises the ball is bouncing extra. Tries to pull out of the shot but it gets a thick edge instead

Finger goes up! It's all over for LSG. Full length delivery on off stump, pace off, Bishnoi looks to push this forward and misses. Gets hit on the back pad. LSG review it. Flat line on UltraEdge. pitching outside off, impact in line and umpire's call. LSG bowl out for 137
Varun gets his third! Full delivery outside off, he looks to slash this, gets a top edge to Russell at cover-point. KKR one wicket away from a massive win
drags the length back a bit, outside off, punched to mid-off
fuller on off stump, picks this up neatly and sends this over long-on for a clean six. Comes from the middle of the bat
fuller, quicker, on off, a swing and a miss. Salt is quick to take the bails off but Yudhvir is safe
fuller around off, goes on one knee and sends this down to long-on
bangs in a bouncer from outside off, tries to pull and misses
Fuller outside off stump, gets a thick inside edge to fine leg
Gone this time! Another top edge and another wicket. Excellent from Salt. Short delivery outside off, Pandya tries to lean back in and play an upper-cut but gets a thick edge to keeper
Dropped! Full delivery outside off, Pandya hits this high over mid-off, Shreyas runs back but couldn't hold on to it
short delivery outside off, guides this on the backfoot to backward point
full length delivery outside off, gets an inside edge to fine leg for one

Off his foot? KKR think it's from Turner's bat. Decision goes to third umpire. Full length ball on off, he tries to hit this across the line, gets an inside edge, it deflects off the boot as Varun dives in front to take a low catch on his followthrough. Unfortunate for Turner!
Effortless! A bit fuller outside off, goes across the line and slog-sweeps this again to off side for a massive six
length ball wide of off goes back and punches this to cover for a run
length ball wide of off, pulled away to leg side
goes back and punches this to cover
Greets him with a six! Fuller around off stump, goes down on one knee, picks it up nicely and slog-sweeps this towards deep midwicket boundary
Cut away to deep point for a run. Ends his spell 4-0-22-1. Too good!
full length on stumps, turning in, he moves across and hits it back to bowler
Fuller on off and middle, steered to short third
Holes out to Starc! fuller outside off stump, he comes down the track to slice it over long-off, Starc runs in a bit and slides to complete the catch. Well-judged!  KKR inching towards win
length ball, quicker on leg stump, pushed to deep square leg
Full on off, leans and guides this to long-on
Goes back and works this to midwicket to keep the strike
full length delivery on leg stump, pace off, he fails to connect
another short delivery, outside off, another wide. KKR review it. Clearly above Turner's head. KKR lose their review
bangs in a bouncer. But too high. wide signalled
drilled to midwicket for a single
full length delivery on leg stump, pushed to deep square leg

Russell strikes again! First Stoinis and then Pooran. Huge, huge wickets. Short of a length delivery outside off stump, Pooran looks to hit this across the line, gets an edge to keeper. Salt jumps high and collects the ball head-high

Dropped? Not an easy catch but you would expect Narine to take it. Back of a length around off , gets a leading to deep third. Narine runs towards the ball but doesn't really put in the effort to catch this
Drilled to vacant midwicket region to a full length delivery outside off
full length outside off, shuffles across and hits back to bowler
length ball on the stumps, flicked to short fine leg
fuller and outside off stump, cut away to deep square leg
fuller around off, flicked to right of long-on
Punched on the backfoot to long-off
yorker on middle stump, drilled to vacant midwicket region for two. excellent running
back of a length ball on the stumps, jams it to short third and takes a risky single
Full length delivery outside off, moves away, Pooran can't reach
Back of a length around off stump, goes back and nudges this to deep midwicket
Oh wow. Badoni gets off the mark with a six! Back of a length delivery around off stump, uses the pace to pull this over deep square leg boundary
Short of a length delivery, wide

Russell takes out Stoinis! Full length ball pitched slightly outside off, nips back in a bit, he gets a leading edge to Rana at point. This is the fifth time Russell has dismissed Stoinis in T20s, says Shastri
Length ball and outside off, under-edges it to keeper
Full and outside off, swept away to deep midwicket
Doesn't middle it well this time. Pulled away towards mid-on for one
Starts with a six! Into the sidescreen. Full length from around the wicket, pitched outside off, whacked it over long-on fence for a 92-m six

Varun strikes in his first over! Hooda reviews. Length ball turns in to the right-hander from outside off stump and hits his front pad. UltraEdge confirms there is no bat involved. Will be umpire's call with impact in front of middle. On-field decision is out, so Hooda has to depart.
Length ball on the hips, guides it to deep midwicket
full length delivery outside off, hit down the ground to long-off for single
Tough returning catch! Half a chance maybe. Length delivery outside off, knocks it back to the bowler, who can't hold on to the ball. Just gets his finger tips on it
Beautiful! Full length delivery on middle and leg, just uses his wrists to flick this away to deep midwicket for a one bounce four
Skipper gone! It's Ramandeep again. Full length delivery outside off stump, Rahul hits this hard but finds Ramandeep at deep point. Easy catch for him this time. Big wicket for Rana and KKR
short ball outside off, pulled away on the backfoot to deep square leg for four
Back of a length delivery on the hips, pulled away to long-on
Flicked to deep midwicket to keep the strike
Four more for Stoinis! Full outside off, creamed it through extra covers for a boundary from the middle of the bat
Full around off, shuffles across and sweeps this straight to short fine leg
Length ball on the stumps, drilled to leg side for a single
Full around off, punches down the ground to left of long-on
Fuller on leg stump, pushed gently to long-on
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, goes back and knocks it back to bowler
Superb delivery. Back of a length ball just slightly outside off, teases the outside edge of Stoinis bat
Low full toss going down the leg, wide
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched on the backfoot to backward point
Short delivery on the hips, uses the pace of the ball to pull this over fine leg boundary for six
Yorker on off and middle stump, 115.9kmph, pace off. Hit back to bowler
Starts with a full delivery on off stump, worked to right of mid-on
Taps it to square leg for a single
Can't find the gap. Full on middle and leg, shuffles across and hits it to covers
Flatter on off stump, punched on the backfoot to cover
Fuller on off stump, goes back and punches towards cover. Shreyas gets a hand on it. LSG will take a couple of runs
Too full and going down the leg, wide signalled
Fuller on middle and leg, Rahul comes down the track to flick it to leg side, misses. Salt appeals for lbw unsuccessfully
Fuller and quicker on stumps, pushed to mid-on
Short of a length ball around off stump, pushed to point
Third four of the over! A cross-seam delivery, pitched slightly short and wide of off, muscled it through covers for four
144.7kmph. Full length ball outside off, this time he hangs back a bit and lofts this over mid-off for a neat four. He is looking so good!
Full length delivery outside off, get down on one knee to smash it, misses
Powerfully struck! Again width on offer. Length ball wide of off stump, he hits it towards cover-point for four
Full length delivery outside off stump, gets an inside edge on to leg side. Will still take a single
Finishes the over with a bouncer, he ducks away
Width on offer, short pitched, Stoinis says thank you and smashes it over deep third region for six. The ball boy takes the catch
full length delivery on leg stump, worked to mid-on for a single
Slightly full outside off, swings back in, pushed to backward point
Length ball on off, drilled to backward square leg

Rahul gone! Length ball around off stump, comes back in sharply as he tries to flick to leg side and looks like he got a tiny edge to keeper. Salt is excited and so is Arora. Umpire's finger goes up. LSG take the review. okay, nothing on UltraEdge. There was a deflection but off the pad. Rahul survives!

Whaaaat a catch! Superb effort from Ramandeep. Full length delivery on middle and off, he looks to flick it towards leg side, gets a leading edge to covers, Ramandeep sprints backward and dives in front of Russell to take the stunning catch. He had to cover a lot of distance for this
length ball around off stump, sticks on to the surface a bit, defended to off side
full length delivery slightly outside off stump, moves away, he lets it go
Full length delivery on middle stump, chipped in between mid on and midwicket. Races away to boundary. 144kmph
Yorker on the stumps, flicked away to mid on for one
Beautiful drive! Full length delivery pitched around off stump, a classy push from the middle of the bat through covers
Glorious! Full length ball on the stumps, hits a straight drive down the ground confidently for four
Length ball swings back in from outside off, taps it to leg side for a single
Gets off the mark. Full length delivery on middle and leg, drilled to deep fine leg
Another inswinger. Full length ball outside off, pushed to covers
Length ball from outside off, nips back in sharply, driven down the ground to mid-off
Starts with a boundary! Length ball pitched outside off, steered to deep third for four
